message:
I continued exploring several TGA variants, but I still haven’t observed the benchmark’s target crash condition. The latest work produced a small set of candidate TGA files for the suspected raw/RLE/indexed paths, but nothing has been accepted as the desired triggering input yet.

I’m not marking this solved.
